question: Using Section 7B.05 and Figure 7B-2, describe the required sign sequence for entering and leaving a reduced school speed-limit zone.
model_answer: Direct Answer: On approach to a reduced school speed limit zone, drivers must first encounter a School (S1-1) sign installed in advance of the speed limit signing, then the School Speed Limit assembly or School Speed Limit When Flashing (S5-1) sign placed at (or as near as practicable to) the point where the reduced zone begins. Where the speed reduction exceeds 10 mph, a Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead (S4-5/S4-5a) sign is recommended in advance, and if used it must be followed by the School Speed Limit signing. Leaving the zone, the downstream end must be marked with an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign. Standards (mandatory): - "A School Speed Limit assembly (see Figure 7B-1) or a School Speed Limit When Flashing (S5-1) sign (see Figure 7B-1) shall be used to indicate the speed limit where a reduced school speed limit zone has been established based upon an engineering study or where a reduced school speed limit is specified for such areas by statute. The School Speed Limit assembly or School Speed Limit When Flashing sign shall be placed at or as near as practicable to the point where the reduced school speed limit zone begins (see Figures 7B-2 and 7B-4)." - "If a reduced school speed limit zone has been established, a School (S1-1) sign shall be installed in advance (see Table 2C-3 for advance placement guidelines) of the first School Speed Limit sign assembly or S5-1 sign that is encountered in each direction as traffic approaches the reduced school speed limit zone (see Figures 7B-2 and 7B-4)." - "If used, the Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead sign shall be followed by a School Speed Limit sign or a School Speed Limit assembly." - "Except as provided in Paragraph 4 of this Section, the downstream end of an authorized and posted reduced school speed limit zone shall be identified with an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign (see Figures 7B-1, 7B-2, and 7B-4)." - Where higher fines apply only to speeding: "a FINES HIGHER (R2-6P), FINES DOUBLE (R2-6aP), or $XX FINE (R2-6bP) plaque shall be posted with the School Speed Limit (S5-1) sign and shall not be posted beneath the School Zone (S1-1) sign (see Section 7B.05)." Guidance (recommended): - "A Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead (S4-5 or S4-5a) sign (see Figure 7B-1) should be used to inform road users of a reduced speed zone where the speed limit is being reduced by more than 10 mph, or where engineering judgment indicates that advance notice would be appropriate." Visual evidence: [Image 3] Figure 7B-2 shows the full sequence in each direction — an advance School (S1-1) sign with optional SCHOOL (S4-3P) plaque, a Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead (S4-5) sign, the School Speed Limit assembly (S4-3P SCHOOL plaque, R2-1 SPEED LIMIT 20, and S4-1P time-of-day plaque) at the beginning of the zone, and an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign (or END SCHOOL ZONE S5-2) with an optional SPEED LIMIT 45 (R2-1) sign at the downstream end. [Image 2] Figure 7B-1 depicts the individual signs and assemblies used in the sequence, including the School Speed Limit Assembly, S5-1 When Flashing sign, S4-5/S4-5a advance signs, and the S5-2/S5-3 end signs. [Image 1] Table 2C-3 provides the advance placement distances used to locate the advance School (S1-1) sign relative to the speed limit assembly. [Image 4] Table 7B-1 lists the sizes of the S1-1, S4-5/S4-5a, S5-1, S5-2, S5-3, and associated plaques in the sequence. [Image 5] Page 1019 contains the Section 7B.05 Standard text establishing this sequence. [Image 7] Page 1016 shows Figure 7B-2 in full-page context. [Image 8] Page 1020 shows a companion example (higher fines only for speeding) with the same entering/leaving sequence plus the R2-6 series plaque on the School Speed Limit assembly. [Image 6] Page 1024 contains the Section 7B.06 provisions on fines plaques associated with the School Speed Limit sign. gold_answer: Approaching traffic first encounters an advance School (S1-1) sign, then the School Speed Limit assembly or S5-1 at the beginning of the reduced zone. The downstream end is normally marked by S5-3 END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT; S5-2 END SCHOOL ZONE may be used when both zones end together, with a downstream R2-1 optionally mounted.
